read.thesis: Q3 beat with AI-native revenue $185M (~13%) and FY26 AI-native floor raised to $650M, but North America still declining and 2027 margin guided flat to lower; utilisation fell to 76.5% from 78.3% in Q2.

utilisation.quote: Utilization was 76.5%, unchanged from Q3 of last year, compared to 78.3% in Q2 of 2026.

triggers.label: Utilisation 78.3% → 76.5% QoQ
triggers.quote: Utilization was 76.5%, unchanged from Q3 of last year, compared to 78.3% in Q2 of 2026.

triggers.label: Three large deals signed, ramp 1H27
triggers.quote: I am happy to report that three of these deals have been signed so far

triggers.label: AI-native FY26 floor $600M → $650M
triggers.quote: EPAM now expects to deliver at least $650 million in AI-native revenues in the year, an increase from our earlier guidance of $600 million.

triggers.label: 2027 gross margin flat to lower
triggers.quote: we are not expecting a further increase in gross margin in the coming year, and we may operate at modestly lower levels of gross margin in 2027.

triggers.label: Software & high-tech revenue down 6.1%
triggers.quote: Software and high tech declined 6.1% year-over-year due to lower spend from certain technology clients, as discussed last quarter.

guidance.quote: EPAM now expects to deliver at least $650 million in AI-native revenues in the year, an increase from our earlier guidance of $600 million.
the company expects to deliver organic constant currency revenue growth of 2.5%-2.7%, at or just above the midpoint of the most recent guidance range.
non-GAAP diluted EPS will now be in the range of $13.23-$13.31 for the full year.
we expect revenue to be in the range of $1.405 billion-$1.420 billion
we are currently expecting to operate in the 15%-16% range for non-GAAP income from operations.
we are committing to returning at least 50% of free cash flow to shareholders annually over each of the next three years, 2027, 2028, and 2029.

prior_guidance_check.quote: EPAM now expects to deliver at least $650 million in AI-native revenues in the year, an increase from our earlier guidance of $600 million.
organic constant currency growth is now expected to be in the range of 2.5%-2.7%.
at a very high level, FB, do you see the company returning to the double-digit growth trajectory

red_flags.label: Non-AI revenue declining; software & high-tech down 6.1%
red_flags.quote: Software and high tech declined 6.1% year-over-year due to lower spend from certain technology clients, as discussed last quarter.

red_flags.label: Q4 organic growth decelerates to 0.5-1.6%
red_flags.quote: organic constant currency growth is expected to be positive and in the range of 0.5%-1.6%.

red_flags.label: Poland R&D benefit halves in 2027
red_flags.quote: the benefit is going to go from about $40 million in 2026 to about $20 million in 2027.

evasions.quote: at a very high level, definitely not in 2027. I do foresee that we can actually get to double-digit growth.

evasions.topic: Large deal win ratio and pipeline sizing
evasions.quote: we are still not sure about our win ratio, because eventually, I don't think it's going to be significantly higher than EPAM average
right now, at this point of time, we are safe as we see it, right?
